Name: Abd al-Rahiim
Rules Text: Spend React: After a strike or action targets a Deverenian Empire character in this rank: Redirect the strike or action to a character adjacent to the original target.
Flavor Text: Not the most devout, but he certainly knows how to impress the commoners.

Name: Ablung's Prisms
Rules Text: Order: Spend Ablung's Prisms and target your character within one rank: This turn, the target gains +1 HP if they are a cleric, +2 ATK if they are a fighter, +2 AC if they are a rogue, and +2 skill if they are a wizard.
Flavor Text: "I know I made it--that doesn't mean I know how they work!" - Otto

Name: Ac'Vuk
Rules Text: At end of turn, if Ac'vuk did not wound an opposing character this turn, kill him.
Flavor Text: "Turn loose Ac'vuk." - Warboss Azh'kal

Name: Adathyn Celestial Messenger
Rules Text: Limited Order: Target up to two of your level 1 or 2 characters: The targets gain +2 ATK and AC and an additional melee strike (base +2) while attacking this turn.
Flavor Text: "The Celestial Gathering has heard your petition, and so I am come."

Name: Alaya
Rules Text: Enter React: Shuffle a card from your hand into your deck: Draw a card.
Flavor Text: "The future isn't the issue--the visions are clear! But when I look to the past, all I see is darkness."

Name: Albrecht Novice
Rules Text: Enter React: Adjacent characters gain +2 ATK and AC this turn.
Flavor Text: Neus the Hunter, Neus the Farmer, Neus the Scribe; each has a military order these days. Only a few still fight for Albrecht.

Name: Alrayn Gaunt
Rules Text: React: After Alrayn Gaunt moves: Perform a melee strike.
Flavor Text: "Behind his grin, a thousand horrors." - That Which Speaks.

Name: Ambitious Squire
Rules Text: Ambitious Squire gains +2 ATK and AC for each adjacent higher level Deverenian Empire character.
Flavor Text: "We shall let the meaningless shed their blood first." - Lord Belasco

Name: Anacaona
Rules Text: Limited React: After an opposing character moves: Your target character Journeys.
Flavor Text: "The Great Water is often unfathomable and dangerous, but with the potential to nourish and strengthen."

Name: Angel's Tears
Rules Text: Order: Discard a card: Perform a +1 ranged strike.
Flavor Text: "Ishara wept, to see her followers so beset. And her tears hardened as they fell." - Sister Amanda

Name: Animal
Flavor Text: "Give him a little scratch behind the ears--He'll love it. Just don't pull his hair or look him in the eyes and avoid the spikes." - Wa'San

Name: Annales Deverenium
Flavor Text: Now there are two versions: one maintained by Skyborne Archivists and another by Church theologians. The bloodthirsty Royals who rule the plains of Deverenia have no use for history.

Name: Annetta Yscar
Rules Text: Limited Order: Your target character gains +3 ATK and the Lycanthrope trait this turn, then performs a melee strike.
Flavor Text: "They haven't even begun to imagine the power of Yscar."

Name: Another Tavern Brawl
Rules Text: Order: Target opponent chooses a character they control: The chosen character performs a melee strike. After the strike, this character performs a melee strike.
Flavor Text: "I'd burn this place to the ground before I share a drink with the likes of you!"

Name: Anvil
Rules Text: Limited Order: Discard a card and target your Dwarven Forges character within two ranks: Equip a Simple Shield token to the target.
Flavor Text: Any Watcher smith could make a fortune on the surface.

Name: Arcane Approach
Rules Text: Order: If this character is a wizard, your target character moves forward one rank. If this character is a fighter, perform a +3 melee strike.
Flavor Text: "Anyone can make the motion, it's the timing that kills." - Commander Retsov

Name: Archivist Augustin
Rules Text: Limited Order: Discard a scribed spell: Destroy target item within two ranks.
Flavor Text: "If we have it, he'll know it." - Librarian Shastra

Name: Archivist Myrina
Rules Text:
After starting armies are revealed, chose a class. Archivist Myrina permanently gains that class.
Limited Order: Your other target Deverenian Empire character gains +1 level this turn.
Flavor Text: "Ah yes, we dealt with a similar situation twenty years ago! Check the archive."

Name: Archivist's Journal
Rules Text:
Charge 1 (enters play with 1 charge counters)
This character's spells gain a bonus to strikes and DC saves equal to the number of charge counters on Archivist's Journal. At end of turn, add a charge counter to Archivist's Journal.
Flavor Text: "Ah yes, we dealt with a similar situation twenty years ago! Check the archive."

Name: Ardent Griffon
Rules Text: Limited Order: Journey
Flavor Text: "Keep your eyes on the sky, young one. Misearean Griffons dive straight from above." -Ra'Gar Root-Strength

Name: Ardian Greathawk
Rules Text:
+3 Skill
React: After an opposing character moves, spend Ardian Greathawk: Journey.
Flavor Text: "A terrible servitude for a free spirit." - Wa'San

Name: Arika Ketchum
Rules Text: Enter Spend React: Search your deck for a Familiar, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
Flavor Text: "The spirits remember what this place used to be."

Name: Aroch Mail
Rules Text: If this character is a cleric or Paladin, other characters in this rank with the same alignment as this character gain +1 ATK and +3 AC.
Flavor Text: "Powerful protection from the Age of Heroes. Its presence inspires us all." - Efrim

Name: Arva of Reclusa
Rules Text: Arva of Reclusa's melee strikes targeting characters more than one rank away spend instead of wound.
Flavor Text: "The reclusas will dine well tonight!"

Name: Ashveil
Rules Text:
Limited Order: Journey.
Limited Order: Target character permamately gains "Death React: Ready target character named Ashveil."
Flavor Text: "They say its a dragon--it's something far worse."

Name: Assassin's Strike
Rules Text: React: Before this character makes a strike roll against a spent character: This character gains advantage for the strike. The strike inflicts an additional wound.
Flavor Text: A knife in the back is worth two in the bush.

Name: Aureliane
Rules Text: Spend Order: Heal an adjacent higher level Deverenian Empire character.
Flavor Text: "The world must know the good we can do."

Name: Balian
Rules Text: Mercenary Guilds characters adjacent to Balian gain +2 AC.
Flavor Text: "Necromancy? Pah! True immortality comes through the Blood Moon."

Name: Balian's Helm
Rules Text: Adjacent characters gain +2 AC.
Flavor Text: It's deeply unpleasant fighting next to Balian when he wears it, but no one can deny that it works.

Name: Bandit Mask
Rules Text: This character gains +1 AC while spent.
Flavor Text: "Take it off before we enter the tavern!" - Master Dresden

Name: Bardiche
Flavor Text: Royal Deverenian nobles are responsible for providing arms and armor to their levies. The thriftiest of them know that all a man-at-arms needs to be effective is a bardiche.

Name: Battleworn Helm
Flavor Text: "What need have I for fresh steel when I have faith?" - Hellene

Name: Beacon
Rules Text:
Limited Order: Wound Beacon: Heal target adjacent non-Warlord character
Limited Order: Perform a melee strike for each wound on Beacon. Heal Beacon.
Flavor Text: "Our warriors watch for him, and draw from his strength." - Memoriam

Name: Bear Legion Recruit
Rules Text: Death React: Your target fighter moves forward one rank.
Flavor Text: Bear Legion's newest members are almost suicidally eager to join the fight.

Name: Berserk
Rules Text: Order: This turn, this character inflicts an additional wound with melee strikes, and opposing characters gain advantage on strike rolls against this character.
Flavor Text: Tancred's Missionaries butchered the remaining elves to the last, deaf to their pleas.

Name: Bickrum Bull-Strength
Rules Text:
For each ki counter on Bikram Bullstrength he gains +3 ATK and an additional melee strike (base +3) while attacking.
Limited Kill React: Put a ki counter on Bikram Bullstrength.
Flavor Text: Perseverance is the greatest virtue of all.

Name: Birdsong Druid
Rules Text: Enter React: Name a card type: Target opponent reveals the top card of their deck. If it is the named type, your target Free Kingdoms character Journeys.
Flavor Text: Listen to the sounds of the forest.

Name: Blackoak Arrows
Rules Text: React: Before this character makes a ranged strike roll: Gain +3 for the die roll.
Flavor Text: "Help yourself-we've got ash, yew, cedar, bloodpine, marshpillar, stoneleaf, blackoak. Personally, I'd recommend the blackoak." - Rone

Name: Blackwind
Rules Text:
Limited Order: Journey.
Spend Order: Target each character in an adjacent rank: Each target must succeed with a magic save (DC 14) or suffer a wound.
Flavor Text: "Lock your doors, silence your cries. Pray for daylight when the black winds rise." - Denskan nursery rhyme

Name: Blade of Antiquity
Rules Text: +5 skill, +1 HP
Flavor Text: "'Twould seem a shame to sully it with their blood." - Lord Belasco

Name: Blast
Rules Text: Order: Perform a +3 ranged strike.
Flavor Text: "SILENCE!" - Barrow

Name: Blessed Vestments
Rules Text: +1 HP
Flavor Text: "It is no coincidence that our smiths and tailors are also our priests" - Memoriam

Name: Blitzer
Rules Text:
Blitzer's melee strikes inflict an additional wound.
Spend Order: Perform a melee strike that may target an additional rank away.
Flavor Text: "What a strange looking elk. Why isn't it running?"

Name: Bloodsteed
Rules Text:
Order: Spend Bloodsteed: Journey.
Destroy Order: Move to any of your ranks.
Flavor Text: He stumbled backwards. Now the sorceress was above him, on the back of a twisted and terrible creature, soaring through the air

Name: Bolt of Unrest
Rules Text: Spend Order: Target an equal or lower level character in a discard pile: Put the target into play ready in your first rank under your control. The target performs a melee strike. Banish the target.
Flavor Text: "Corpses know the horror of death. They itch to return to the world of living." - Tazian

Name: Bone Fiend
Rules Text:
At end of turn, kill your Elven Branches character or banish an Elven Branches character in your discard pile.
Order: Kill your other Undead: Bone Fiend gains +3 ATK this turn.
Flavor Text: "A whirlwind of shards, flying in all directions. Don't use them as bodyguards." - Tazian

Name: Breastplate
Flavor Text: "We'll need thirty more, for the new recruits from Calenar." - Efrim

Name: Breastplate of Power
Rules Text: Other characters in this rank gain +2 ATK and AC.
Flavor Text: "To me, warriors of Deverenia! Denska shall be ours once again!" - Lord Belasco

Name: Brigand Buckler
Rules Text: +2 skill
Flavor Text: "You've got be quick on your feet, that buckler isn't going to stop much." - Rone

Name: Brightwing
Rules Text:
Limited Order: Journey.
Limited Order: Target your character: Heal the target. The target may Journey.
Flavor Text: "All traces of corruption must be purged from the land."

Name: Brine Fiend
Flavor Text: "My cousin tried to ride one once.... He was a good man."

Name: Brinewater Croc
Rules Text: Adjacent Sutek gain +2 ATK and "Limited Order: Perform a melee strike that spends instead of wounds.
Flavor Text: "If there's one thing you can say for the sutek, they ride in style." - Rone

Name: Bruntor's Helm
Rules Text: +1 HP
Flavor Text: "For the legendary helm of a mythical Denskan king, it sure pops up a lot." - Salvage

Name: Burning Scroll
Rules Text: Order: Spend Burning Scroll: Perform a +3 ranged strike.
Flavor Text: "A classic. I've read it more times than I can count." - Barrow

Name: Callow Rowan
Rules Text: Limited React: Before a character you control dies: Put a character into play. You may reduce the character's entering rank by one.
Flavor Text: "For too long have we confined our search to the Essences--this world contains powers more primordial."

Name: Catapult Crew
Rules Text: Spend Order: Perform a +5 ranged strike that may target an additional rank away.
Flavor Text: "It shoots too far! I wanna shoot it and see it crush 'em!" - Sklot the Cruel

Name: Change of Hands
Rules Text: Spend Order: Target a character within two ranks: Return an item equipped to the target to its owner's hand. If a Bow, Shield, or Weapon is returned this way, the target's controller discards a card.
Flavor Text: "Very kind of you to deliver this to me." -Dresden

Name: Chant
Rules Text: Adjacent Dwarven Forges characters gain +2 AC.
Flavor Text: As the front lines slammed together, the chanting of the dwarves drowned out the sounds of battle.

Name: Charm Person
Rules Text: Order: Target lower level character may not attack this turn.
Flavor Text: "Your generosity will not go unrewarded." - Shastra

Name: Cheap Sword
Rules Text: Death React: Return Cheap Sword to your hand.
Flavor Text: "Thou shalt have the good steel when thou hast earned it." - Tancred

Name: Choke
Rules Text: Spend Order: Spend target equal or lower level character within one rank.
Flavor Text: "Open your eyes!" Gorthos screamed, manhandling the helpless dwarf. "Witness the true gods!"

Name: Chovan Voidcaller
Rules Text: Spend Order: Target a lower level character within 3 ranks: Heal or wound the target.
Flavor Text: The earth hungers for the Abyss!

Name: Church Enforcer Tancred
Rules Text: Limited Order: Your target character performs a melee strike that inflicts an additional wound against characters that are equal or lower level than the target.
Flavor Text: "Would'st thou refuse the tender embrace of the Church?"

Name: Church Inquisitor
Flavor Text: "The flames will feast on the unbelievers, they can hide no longer!"

Name: Ciane
Rules Text: React: Before Ciane makes a melee strike roll: He gains +5 ATK for the strike and the strike inflicts an additional wound. Inflict a wound on him after the strike.
Flavor Text: "These fleshers have odd ideas about what it means to be alive. We might learn something from them." - Shyessa

Name: Cleave
Rules Text: React: Before this character makes a melee strike roll: The strike inflicts an additional wound.
Flavor Text: There are two kinds of nothrog: the kind who swing wildly, and the kind who kill you as you stumble back from the wild ones.

Name: Cloak of Brilliance
Flavor Text: Shastra whirled her cloak around her, and in a blinding flash of light she was gone.

Name: Cloak of Flight
Rules Text:
This character's spells gain the Arcane trait
Order: Spend Cloak of Flight: Journey.
Flavor Text: "You can use it go forwards, too, coward." - Tazian

Name: Close Wounds
Rules Text: Spend Order: Target your character within one rank: Heal the target. The target gains +1 HP this turn.
Flavor Text: "Heal them once, and they won't mind getting hit the next time." - Azh'kal

Name: Cloudracer
Rules Text:
Order: Discard a card: Journey.
Order: Spend Cloudracer: Journey.
Flavor Text: "I have the powers of a dozen beasts, but there's nothing for speed like a Cloudracer." - Annetta

Name: Commander Retsov
Rules Text:
Your Dragons suffer no loyalty penalty.
Limited Order: Discard a card: Put an equal or lower level character from your hand into play adjacent to Commander Retsov.
Flavor Text: "Our investment is paying off."

Name: Corpse Crowd
Rules Text: Death React: Each adjacent character named Corpse Crowd gains +3 ATK and +1 HP permanently.
Flavor Text: "Banal, but effective." - Tazian

Name: Courage from Faith
Rules Text: Order: Unstun target character.
Flavor Text: "There is always hope!" - Anacaona

Name: Coward
Rules Text:
Your deck may include any number of cards named Coward.
Coward is the same factions as your Warlords.
Flavor Text: "Go ahead, I'm... uh... right behind you."

Name: Crimson Diadem
Rules Text: Limited Order: Wound any number of your characters: This character gains +3 skill this turn for each character wounded this way.
Flavor Text: Tazian raised the circlet to eye-level. "Interesting--where did you say you found this?"

Name: Crownland Strategist
Rules Text: Spend Order: Discard the top card of an opponent's deck: Perform a ranged strike with a bonus equal to the card's level.
Flavor Text: "Just as we thought they would, my lord. Now we spring our trap."

Name: Crush
Rules Text: React: Before this character makes a melee strike roll: Gain +5 ATK for the strike. If the strike hits, destroy one item equipped to the target of the strike.
Flavor Text: IF DWARF: "Their works are insults to the gods. Destroy them all." - Gorthos / IF NOTHROG: "Get Mugg over here, we need him for something!"

Name: Crypt Wine
Rules Text: React: Before this character makes a ranged strike roll: The strike inflicts an additional wound.
Flavor Text: When an elf dies, their body is put to use, Flesh for leather, bone for armor, blood to be fermented in the crypts.

Name: Cumbersome Helm
Flavor Text: "Stop complaining and keep it on! If you take it off and an arrow goes through your eye, then you really won't be able to see anything." - Malexin

Name: Cunning Shot
Rules Text: Order: Perform a +4 ranged strike that does not inflict wounds. If the strike hits, spend the target and move them forward one rank.
Flavor Text: "Proceed with caution-Goldengrove arrows usually find their mark." - Tazian

Name: Curse of Greed
Rules Text:
React: After target character pays the cost of an action to draw or retrieve a card from their deck: Cancel the action and wound the target.
Spend Order: Wound this character: Draw a card.
Flavor Text: "There are worse things than lycanthropy in this world..." - Annetta

Name: Cutlass
Rules Text:
Riposte +4
React: After this character succeeds with a Riposte check: Move backward one rank or to another position in this rank.
Flavor Text: "Heavy enough to cut thick rope, short enough to use shoulder-to-shoulder. Make sure everyone on the ship has one." - Retsov

Name: Cyldragen's Tome
Rules Text: Spend Order: Spend Cyldragen's Tome and discard a card: Search your deck for an equal or lower level Dragon and put it into play adjacent to this character, then shuffle.
Flavor Text: The Cyldragen's translations of the Dragon's primordial magic disappeared when he did.

Name: Darkflame Bolts
Rules Text: Spend Order: Target two characters within two ranks: Each target must succeed with a reflex save (DC 8 + this character's skill) or suffer a wound.
Flavor Text: "Watch closely, and don't try this one near the library." - Lord Barrow

Name: Darkwatcher
Rules Text:
May equip fighter items.
Limited Order: Journey.
Limited Order: Ready target item.
Flavor Text: "A miraculous creature, our champion in the darkness."

Name: Death from Below
Rules Text: React: After target opposing character moves into a rank two ranks away: Perform a +4 ranged strike against the target.
Flavor Text: "Theessse human swimmersss always look to the sssurface when the danger liesss below." - Z'adok

Name: Deverenus' Axe
Rules Text: React: After this character hits with a melee strike: The target of the strike and up to one opposing character adjacent to the target must succeed with a reflex save (DC 18) or spend and suffer a wound.
Flavor Text: "Deverenus beheaded his sister Deima in the holy city of Athanaes. All heretics shall face the same fate." - Tancred

Name: Disperse
Rules Text: Spend React: After target opposing character pays the cost of an action card: The target must succeed with a will save (DC 10 + this character's skill) or the action is canceled.
Flavor Text: "Wouldn't this be better as a real shield?" - Gadgeteer Bilder

Name: Dissolve
Rules Text: Spend Order: Target an item within two ranks that is lower level than this character's level +5: Destroy the item.
Flavor Text: "The Storm is the root of this world. Of course it's magic is arcane as well as divine." - Lady Estelle

Name: Divine Barrier
Rules Text: React: After target character targets this character with a melee strike: Perform a melee strike against the target.
Flavor Text: "Steel, Discipline, Faith-each will protect you. Embrace them." - Anvil

Name: Divine Respite
Rules Text:
Roll Order: Target your other character,
1-9: Unstun the target.
10-19: Ready the target.
20: Ready the target. It gains +4 ATK and AC this turn.
Flavor Text: "Ease your mind! Give your troubles over to the Storm." - Hellene

Name: Dizzying Footwork
Rules Text: React: Before target character makes a strike roll: The target suffers disadvantage for the strike.
Flavor Text: Sklot wiped the sweat from his brow. "Can barely keep up with myself these days."

Name: Doo'Run
Rules Text: Limited React: Before Doo'run suffers wounds: Perform a melee strike.
Flavor Text: "Blood is blood, mine or my enemy's."

Name: Dragon's Blood
Rules Text: Destroy React: Before casting a wizard spell: This character gains +2 levels for casting the spell.
Flavor Text: "No, you can't have any. Figure out how to get it yourself." - Lord Barrow

Name: Draljaca Tar
Rules Text: Spend Order: Target character within one rank suffers -5 AC this turn.
Flavor Text: "I curse you by ash and willow! By bog and fen!"

Name: Dreadfang
Rules Text:
Limited Order: Journey.
React: After Dreadfang hits target character with a melee strike: The target must succeed with a poison save (DC 16) or suffer a wound.
Flavor Text: "Who can say how long it's lived in the swamp? I wouldn't get close enough to ask it." - Anacaona

Name: Dress
Rules Text: Your Dwarven Forges characters in this rank gain +3 AC while they have one or more wounds.
Flavor Text: "It's not deep. Wrap him up and send him back to the front."

Name: Duke Richter
Rules Text:
Ward
Limited React: After Duke Richter is targeted with a strike: Cancel the strike.
Flavor Text: "I shall show you the power of blood magic!"

Name: Dupe
Rules Text: React: After this character is targeted by a melee strike, move to a different position in this rank: The strike is a critical failure and the character performing the strike must succeed with a dexterity save (DC 8 + this character's skill) or be unable to perform melee strikes this turn.
Flavor Text: "Masters of tactics? They just fell for the oldest trick in the book!" - Rone

Name: Dwarf-Eater
Rules Text:
Dwarf-Eater's Melee Strikes gain +4 ATK while targeting Dwarven Forges characters and +3 ATK for each wound on the target.
Limited React: After Dwarf-Eater performs a melee strike that hit target character: Perform a melee strike against the target.
Flavor Text: "They're too tough for my tassste, but to each their own." - Sta'ash

Name: Eager Blade
Rules Text: If this character moved this turn, they gain advantage on melee strikes.
Flavor Text: "Near as thirsty as I am!" - Doo'run

Name: Eager Novice
Flavor Text: "Point it that way, fool." - Tancred

Name: Earthen Embrace
Rules Text: Spend Order: Heal each character in play. For each character healed this way, your target character gains +3 skill this turn.
Flavor Text: "The Earth itself fights with the dwarves!" - Memoriam

Name: Efrim Dawntreader
Rules Text:
Your other characters gain +2 ATK and AC while in a rank with a level 4 or higher Paladin.
Order: Banish target Level 1 Free Kingdoms character from your discard pile: Your target character Journeys.
Flavor Text: "Fell deeds await. For faith and courage we ride."

Name: Epic Betrayal
Rules Text:
Roll Order: Target a spent character within one rank,
1-9: Perform a melee strike against the target.
10-19: Perform a melee strike against the target that inflicts an additional wound.
20: Perform a melee strike against the target. If the strike hits, the target is killed.
Flavor Text: "We were never friends." - Lord Belasco

Name: Epic Donnybrook
Rules Text:
Roll Spend Order:
1-9: Perform three melee strikes.
10-19: Perform three melee strikes. This character gains Reach for these strikes.
20: Perform a melee strike targeting each opposing character within two ranks.
Flavor Text: Veteran brawlers will chop off their own pinky, to show they don't need all ten fingers to clobber you.

Name: Epic Evocation
Rules Text:
Roll Spend Order: Target up to two opposing characters in different ranks,
1-9: Inflict a wound on each non-Warlord target.
10-19: Inflict a wound on each target.
20: Banish each non-Warlord target.
Flavor Text: "Our gods died a millennia ago. Yours will shortly join them." - Tazian

Name: Epic Judgement
Rules Text:
Roll Order:
1-9: Banish target level 1 character.
10-19: Banish target level 1 or 2 character.
20: Choose level 1 or 2, then wound each opposing character of the chosen level.
Flavor Text: "All of the heavens judge you now, beast." - Adathan

Name: Essence Drain
Rules Text: Order: Target character within two ranks must succeed with a fortitude save (DC 15) or suffer -1 level and -1 HP this turn.
Flavor Text: "Do not despair. Rest assured I will put your Essence to good use." - Barrow

Name: Even the Odds
Rules Text: Order: Gain +1 ATK and AC for each opposing character within one rank this turn. If there are five or more opposing characters within one rank, gain Ward this turn.
Flavor Text: As the fight dragged on and the humans began to tire, Vactus seemed to grow larger and stronger, a mad gleam in his eyes.

Name: Everwarm Elixir
Rules Text: Destroy Order: This character gains +4 ATK and Frost Resistance this turn.
Flavor Text: "I need your strongest potions, for I am going into battle." - Jorra the Morose

Name: Farhaven Guide
Rules Text: Spend Order: Search your deck for a lower level action card, reveal it, and put it into your hand, then shuffle. Banish Farhaven Guide.
Flavor Text: "Seal the gates. Go block by block. The Church is in here somewhere." - Mair

Name: Fateshift
Rules Text: Spend React: Before target character suffers wounds, reveal the top card of your deck: Reduce the wounds by one. The target gains a bonus to AC this turn equal to the level of the card revealed this way this turn.
Flavor Text: "Nothing is predetermined. We control our own destinies." - Anacaona

Name: Fatestring Bow
Rules Text: Order: Spend Fatestring Bow: discard the top card of an opponent's deck. Perform a ranged strike with a bonus equal to the discarded card's level.
Flavor Text: Every shot an eternity, every arrow a destiny remade.

Name: Field Marshall Malexin
Rules Text:
Opposing characters suffer disadvantage on ranged strike rolls against Field Marshal Malexin.
Your characters in this rank inflict an additional wound with melee strikes targeting higher level characters.

Name: Final Blessing
Rules Text:
React: After target character pays the costs of an action to retrieve cards from a discard pile: Cancel the action. The target suffers a wound.
React: Before target character suffers wounds: The target gains +1 HP this turn.
Flavor Text: "We commend thee to the sky, to the wind, to the Storm. Give up thy soul and welcome Eternity."

Name: Final Farewell
Rules Text: Death React: Perform a +2 melee strike that inflicts an additional wound.
Flavor Text: It's the last thing you'll ever do-might as well have some fun with it.

Name: Fineltour's Draught
Rules Text: Order: Spend Fineltour's Draught: This turn, this character suffers disadvantage on strike rolls, and opposing characters suffer disadvantage on strike rolls targeting this character.
Flavor Text: It was no accident Fineltour survived the Dragon when so many other gods died.

Name: Fire Brand
Rules Text:
Order: This character gain Fire Resistance this turn.
Order: This character's damage type becomes Fire and their strikes ignore Planar this turn.
Flavor Text: "I'm not much of a reader, but I like this!" - Sklot the Cruel

Name: Fireball
Rules Text: Spend Order: Perform a +4 ranged strike. After the strike, any characters who were adjacent to the target must succeed with a magic save (DC 9) or suffer a wound.
Flavor Text: Nothrog legionnaires have come to prefer burnt meat.

Name: FireReign Idol
Rules Text: Destroy Order: Target your character within one rank: Unstun the target. The target gains Fire Resistance this turn.
Flavor Text: "One of the few religious icons not allowed in Athanaes; the risk of explosion is too high." - Anacaona

Name: Flail
Rules Text: This character's melee strikes ignore AC bonuses from Shields and Weapons.
Flavor Text: "Make sure you hit them. You don't want those spikes coming back around." - Malexin

Name: Flame Jester
Flavor Text: His dark grin halted their laughter.

Name: Flamefall
Rules Text: Order: Spend your character in this rank: Move forward up to two ranks.
Flavor Text: "For too long have I watched forests burned and rivers sullied."

Name: Flamelance
Rules Text:
Wounds from this action may not be reduced.
Order: Perform a +5 ranged strike.
Spend Order: Perform a +5 ranged strike that inflicts an additional wound.
Flavor Text: "They aren't sutek!! They're dragons!" - last words of a confused Merrick farmer

Name: Flurry of Knives
Rules Text: Spend Order: Perform three +2 ranged strikes.
Flavor Text: "No one is ever prepared for a lycanthrope to start throwing knives." - Annetta

Name: Frameseer
Rules Text: Enter React: Survey.
Flavor Text: "The Web runs deep in this world. Great evils, above and below."

Name: Freelance Cavalier
Rules Text: Freelance Cavalier is the same alignments, factions, and classes as your Warlords.
Flavor Text: "My horse needs paid, too."

Name: Frenzy
Rules Text: React: After Frenzy suffers wounds: He gains +6 ATK and his melee strikes inflict an additional wound this turn.
Flavor Text: Above the surface or below, few can withstand a charge from the Blackstone Raiders.

Name: Gadgeteer Bilder
Rules Text: Spend Order: Target an Encumbered character within two ranks: Ready or destroy an item equipped to the target.
Flavor Text: "I will stay until my work is finished."

Name: Gapfinder
Rules Text: During melee strikes against spent characters, this character gains +5 ATK.
Flavor Text: "Any plate, no matter how heavy, has gaps." - Mair

Name: Genecourt Initiate
Rules Text: Death React: The next strike targeting your character this turn is a critical failure.
Flavor Text: "The purge is coming. Our soldiers are ready." - Tancred Genecourt

Name: Ghed Bane
Rules Text:
Opposing lower level characters within one rank have -2 ATK and AC.
Limited Order: Move forward one rank.
Flavor Text: "Millions of echoes, screaming together in eternity. Come! Join them!"

Name: Ghed Daucet
Rules Text: Limited React: After target character within one rank attacks: If that character's ATK is lower than Daucet's level, stun the target.
Flavor Text: "I have emerged from Darkness. The Storm cannot be far behind."

Name: Gift From Above
Rules Text: Order: Target character gains a bonus to ATK and AC equal to this character's level this turn.
Flavor Text: "You may swing the sword, but Neus will decide your fate." - Adathan

Name: Glaciate
Rules Text: Order: Target character within three ranks must succeed with a fortitude save (DC 5 + this wizard's skill) or stun and attach Glaciate. Attached character suffers -2 ATK, AC, and Skill.
Flavor Text: "I am sorry, but you must be stopped." - Wa'San Wolf-Spirit

Name: Glimmer
Rules Text: Spend Order: Target character suffers a penalty to their skill equal to this character's skill this turn.
Flavor Text: "Look closely: you can see the shimmer of Spirit around any living creature. Now reach out and tear it." - Tazian

Name: Goldengrove Mage
Rules Text: Limited Order: Target character within two ranks must succeed with a will save (DC 9 + Goldengrove Mage's skill) or suffer a wound.
Flavor Text: Of course, the Goldengrove have not completely abandoned their elven heritage.

Name: Gorthos, Shadow's Axe
Rules Text: Limited Order: Your target Barbarian gains +5 ATK, +2 HP, and an additional strike (base +0) while attacking this turn. The target may not perform actions other than to attack or maneuver this turn.
Flavor Text: "Kor has lied to us! The Abyss is here. It always has been, and it always will be!"

Name: Graham Heyward
Rules Text:
While adjacent to an equal or higher level Free Kingdoms, Graham Heyward gains Marksmanship +5.
Spend Order: Perform a +3 ranged strike. Perform a +0 ranged strike.
Flavor Text: "Loose! May Neus judge them justly."

Name: Grand Inventor Otto
Rules Text:
Otto gains +1 level for equipping items.
Limited Order: Equip a trap token to each of your characters in your first rank without a Trap equipped.
Flavor Text: "You don't need wings to fly!"

Name: Grave Exchange
Rules Text: Spend Order: Perform two +5 ranged strikes. If a character would be killed by this action, banish it instead and put a character from your discard pile into play.
Flavor Text: She collapsed, head thrown backwards, mouth locked in a rictus grin. The remaining four ran faster.

Name: Graveyard Librarian
Rules Text: Spend Order: Perform a +3 ranged strike. If the strike would kill the target, banish it instead.
Flavor Text: He followed his master closely, maybe too closely…

Name: Green Flower Warden
Rules Text:
Greenflower Warden gains +1 level for casting spells.
Limited Order: Discard a card from your hand or the top card of your deck.
Flavor Text: "A battle in distant Tyraniel-listen to the leaves, they tell the tale."

Name: Griffon of Andover
Rules Text: Limited Order: Spend Griffon of Andover: Journey. Opposing characters may not react to or during this action.
Flavor Text: "Efrim has offered an egg in exchange for a squadron's barding? I didn't know they bred!" -Otto

Name: Grimfey Prowler
Rules Text: Grimfey Prowler gains a bonus to ATK equal to his skill while performing melee strikes targeting spent characters.
Flavor Text: "These other elves are terrified. Let us ease them of their burden."

Name: Grovewarden Elumera
Rules Text:
After starting armies are revealed, choose a class. Grovewarden Elumera permanently gains that class.
Limited Order: Your other target Elven Branches character gains +3 skill this turn.
Flavor Text: "We shall not run from death!"

Name: Guard Duty
Rules Text: Order: This character gains +1 HP and Defend +10 this turn.
Flavor Text: "The most important thing in a war is to know where your opponent can be, and where they can't be." - Retsov

Name: Hagunk
Rules Text: Hagunk's ranked strikes may target an additional rank away.
Flavor Text: "Fire isn't Nature's foe. It's a lifegiver, a renewer, and yes, a protector."

Name: Havat-lahn Stance
Rules Text: This character gains an additional melee strike (base +1) while attacking.
Flavor Text: "An ancient practice, but sound. Every Skyborne Wayfinder is drilled in the Havat-lahn from youth." - Shastra

Name: Hazahk of Shadow
Rules Text: Hazahk of Shadow and adjacent characters gain +5 ATK while wounded.
Flavor Text: "I am Trample no longer!"

Name: Heavy Crossbow
Rules Text:
Spend Order: Perform a +4 ranged strike.
Spend Order: Perform a +2 ranged strike targeting a character three ranks away.
Flavor Text: The beasts of Sarakia have learned to stay well away from the walls of Seeker cities.

Name: Heresy Huntress
Flavor Text: "Oh yes--the Yscarites have been here."

Name: Heresy Ward
Rules Text: Order: Spend Heresy Ward: Your other target character gains +3 AC this turn, and an additional +3 AC while targeted by spells this turn.
Flavor Text: "The magic of lesser beings crumbles before the might of Neus." - Adathan

Name: Heroic Confrontation
Rules Text: Order: Perform a melee strike that inflicts an additional wound against higher level characters.
Flavor Text: The knights stopped and stared as a handful of nothrog charged into the mass of Deverenians.

Name: High Acolyte Hellene
Rules Text:
Your level 4 Deverenian Empire characters may enter play as if they were one level lower.
Limited React: After High Acolyte Hellene targets your Deverenian Empire character with a spell: Spend target non-Warlord character in an opposing first rank.
Flavor Text: The Church demands devotion. The Storm blesses those who give it

Name: Hinterlands Griffon
Rules Text: Limited Order: If you control a Mercenary Guilds Warlord: Journey.
Flavor Text: "Take care, lad, not all griffons are friends." - Efrim

Name: Hod's Legacy
Rules Text:
Unique
Spend Order: Spend Hod's Legacy: Ready target lower level non-stunned character of the same faction.
Order: Spend Hod's Legacy: Unstun target lower level character of the same faction.
Flavor Text: "Hod died hundreds of years ago, holding off the Abyss. He continues to fight." - Memoriam

Name: Holy Might
Rules Text: Order: Target a character: The target gains either +3 ATK or +3 AC this turn. Heal the target.
Flavor Text: Kor protects those who uphold the Watcher's Vow.

Name: Hrun Instigator
Rules Text: Limited Order: Target an opposing character within one rank: The target performs a melee strike. After the strike, Hrun Instigator performs a melee strike with advantage.
Flavor Text: "Lure them downwards and tear them apart." - Gorthos

Name: Huggins
Flavor Text: "You have my brothers you foul beast, I ask you to leave, for if you stay here on my claws you shall feast!." Azh'kal just smirked and boastfully said, "A hero you may be, but I will soon have your head!" - The Ballad of the Bear and his Merry Men

Name: Hunt From Above
Rules Text: Order: Gain Stealth +10 this turn. Survey. If this character is a Scout, gain True Strike this turn.
Flavor Text: "When we go in, we go fast enough they can't follow." - Mair

Name: Hunter Merril
Rules Text:
After starting armies are revealed, choose a class. Hunter Merril permanently gains that class.
Limited Order: Your other target Free Kingdoms character gains +3 AC this turn.
Flavor Text: "Neus gave us tools, we must use them."

Name: Hunting Staff
Rules Text: Order: Spend Hunting Staff and target an adjacent character: The target moves forward one rank.
Flavor Text: "They are clossse! Quickly, before they ssslip away!" - Sta'ash

Name: I Have Your Back
Rules Text: React: After another character in this rank is targeted with a strike: Redirect the strike to this character.
Flavor Text: Safety in numbers.

Name: Improvised Weapon
Rules Text: React: Before this character makes a melee strike roll: This character gains +3 ATK and is considered to have a Weapon equipped for the strike.
Flavor Text: "Some say it's always best to have a weapon. I prefer to fight bear-handed." - Annetta, lycanthrope

Name: Invoke the Storm
Rules Text:
Spend Order: Put a Stormlord character token into play ready in your first rank. It's a level 5 evil Deverenian Empire Stormwraith fighter with
+7/+7 lightning ATK, 8 AC, +7 skill, 3 HP, Planar, and "At end of turn, kill one of your Deverenian Empire characters."
Flavor Text: "Behold its power!" - Hellene

Name: Isadran Kennelmaster
Flavor Text: "A squadron of Deverenians slipped through Condor Pass last night. Track them down."

Name: Jigoral
Rules Text: Spend Order: Perform a +0 ranged strike.
Flavor Text: "It's clear that spirits speak to Jigoral. If those are the gods that the Goldengrove seek, I am not sure I'd like to meet them." - Rone

Name: Joleg
Rules Text: Adjacent Nothrog Legions characters gain +2 ATK.
Flavor Text: "Why is it always here, and how does it always survive?" -Azh'kal

Name: Jubilant Hatchling
Rules Text: Death React: Heal each of your characters within one rank.
Flavor Text: "They say it's adorable. I tell them it's a wood-cracking monstrosity we're keeping on a wooden ship." - Jorra the Morose

Name: Jump
Rules Text: Order: Journey.
Flavor Text: Parthus gaped as the red-robed mage leapt into the air, soaring off the cliff in a graceful arc that brought her gently down on a neighboring peak. "Whoah."

Name: Kabalite Regalia
Rules Text: React: After this character casts a spell, spend Kaballite Regalia: Target character within two ranks must succeed with a reflex save (DC 5 + this character's skill) or spend and suffer a wound.
Flavor Text: Rarely do the wizards of the Kabal collaborate on projects. But when they do, the results are spectacular.

Name: Kazkah
Rules Text:
After starting armies are revealed, choose a class. Kazkah permanently gains that class.
Limited Order: Your other target Nothrog Legions character gains +3 ATK this turn.
Flavor Text: "We don't just have the strength, we know how to use it."

Name: Keep Watch
Rules Text:
Order: Survey.
Spend React: After a character in this rank is targeted with a strike: Cancel the strike.
Flavor Text: "It's never just about the here and now." - Anacaona

Name: Kingslayer
Rules Text:
Limited Order: Journey.
Limited Order: Target an Encumbered character within one rank: Spend or ready the target.
Flavor Text: "They say it feeds on the blood of lesser fiends." - Lord Belasco

Name: Kor's Aegis
Rules Text: Order: Twice per turn, wound this character: Heal your target character in a first rank.
Flavor Text: Broken during Kor's struggle with the Dragon, the Watcher's Vow has reforged it over the course of decades.

Name: Kor's Patience
Rules Text: Order: Perform a +5 ranged strike that stuns instead of wounds.
Flavor Text: "Best not try it further." - Memoriam

Name: Kraig'dem
Rules Text: Order: Spend your adjacent character: Perform a +4 ranged strike
Flavor Text: "Funny little humans. You think you invented this magic? It is more ancient than your entire race..."

Name: Kurak Stonejaw
Rules Text:
Kurak may perform Defend twice per turn, and is considered adjacent to each of your Dwarven Forges characters for using it.
Limited Order: Perform a melee strike. If the target performed a strike this turn, this strike inflicts an additional wound.
Flavor Text: "Something evil rises. The Watchers must keep their Vow."

Name: Lady Estelle
Rules Text: Limited Order: Target a lower level character in an opposing front rank: The target must succeed with a will save (DC15) or spend.
Flavor Text: There is more than one way to know the Storm.

Name: Leonora
Rules Text: Limited Order: Leonora gains an additional melee strike (base +0) while attacking this turn.
Flavor Text: "I don't why more and more of these electrified people are showing up, but it makes my fur stand on end."

Name: Leopard Claws
Rules Text: This character gains an additional melee strike while attacking with a base bonus equal to their lowest base ATK bonus.
Flavor Text: "What pathetic tools thessse humans ussse, to mimic their bettersss!" - Z'adok

Name: Leveled Up
Flavor Text: "If you aren't learning you're losing." - Azh'kul

Name: Leveled!
Rules Text: React: After this character performs a strike or action that killed an opposing character of equal or higher level: This character permanently gains +1 level, +3 ATK, +3 AC, +2 skill, and +1 HP. Banish this card.
Flavor Text: "If you aren't learning, you're losing." - Azh'kal

Name: Librarian Shastra
Rules Text: Limited Order: Discard a card and target two characters within three ranks: The targets must succeed with a Will save (DC 15) or spend.
Flavor Text: "That tome is an important artifact! It belongs in a library!"

Name: Lightning Blast
Rules Text: Spend Order: Perform a +5 ranged strike. If the target is Encumbered, the strike gains an additional +5.
Flavor Text: "Thine armor is as useless as thy sword, cretin." - Lord Belasco

Name: Lights of Revealing Sword
Rules Text:
Order: Reveal the top 10 cards of your deck: Put a Weapon revealed this way into your hand, then shuffle.
Order: Target character gains +5 ATK this turn.

Name: Lord Barrow
Rules Text:
Once per turn, Lord Barrow may cast a level 1 or 2 wizard spell from your discard pile, then banish that spell.
React: After Lord Barrow casts a spell: Perform a +0 ranged strike.
Flavor Text: Since that fateful night in the graveyard, Barrow has never been the same.

Name: Lord Belasco
Rules Text: Limited Order: Move target equal or lower level character forward or backward one rank. This move may not create an illegal rank.
Flavor Text: "What do we need of the storm? We have more exquisite methods now." - Belasco

Name: Lord's Assailant
Rules Text: React: After your wizard casts a spell: Journey.
Flavor Text: "The research requires more skulls." - Lord Barrow

Name: Luthlarius Regalia
Rules Text:
+1 HP
React: After this character casts a spell: Target character within two ranks must succeed with a reflex save (DC 5 + this character's skill) or stun.
Flavor Text: "The Herald shall stand upon the mountain top and blow Signon's Horn, and the Storm shall reappear and drown the World." - the Prophecies of Hierophant Malleon

Name: 'Mad' Pat Carrik
Rules Text: 'Mad' Pat Carrik inflicts an additional wound with melee strikes.
Flavor Text: "What he lacks in wits, he makes up for with enthusiasm." - Doo'run

Name: Magic Missiles
Rules Text: Spend Order: Perform a number of +0 ranged strikes equal to this wizard's Level. These strikes may not receive bonuses to the die roll.
Flavor Text: "Run all you like. It will not save you." -Barrow

Name: Mair Haven
Rules Text:
During the Order phase, opponents play with the top card of their decks revealed. Mair Haven gains a bonus to ranged strikes equal to the highest level card revealed this way.
Spend Order: Look at the top three cards of target opponent's deck, then put them back in any order. Perform two +2 ranged strikes.
Flavor Text: "Two arrows, one in each eye. Basic counter-intelligence"

Name: Makusog Steelhorn
Rules Text:
Adjacent Siege characters gain +2 to strike rolls.
Limited Order: Your target Siege moves forward one rank.
Flavor Text: When the Siegemasters build something too heavy for giants, the Legions turn to the makusog.

Name: Master Dresden
Rules Text: Limited React: After your character moves: Target opposing character must succeed with a will save (DC 15) or spend. If you control a Mercenary Guilds Warlord, you may use this ability twice per turn.
Flavor Text: "It shall be done, Commander."

Name: Medical Kit
Rules Text: "Neus helps most those who help themselves." - Adathan

Name: Meet at the Inn!
Rules Text: Order: Each player may draw a card. You may draw an additional card (two total).
Flavor Text: "I guess we can have one more before we leave, what's the worst that could happen?"

Name: Melt Metal
Rules Text: Order: Target a character within two ranks: For each item the target has equipped, they must succeed with a fortitude save (DC 13) or suffer a wound.
Flavor Text: "You can apply every artificer's trick there is. The metal still belongs to Nature." -Wa'San

Name: Memoriam
Rules Text: Limited Order: Target your non-stunned Dwarven Forges character in a front rank: Heal and ready the target.
Flavor Text: "A thousand years of Dwarven history have led to this moment, and you all are the beginning of the next thousand years!"

Name: Mephit
Rules Text: Limited Order: Journey (move forward or backward one rank).
Flavor Text: Misbegotten byproducts of magical accidents, the only relief they know is inflicting their pain on others.

Name: Merrick Regalia
Rules Text:
+4 skill
Order: Twice per turn, banish a rogue action from your discard pile: Perform a +8 ranged strike.
Flavor Text: "The Cartwrights blazed the way for the Hunters. They fought the same enemies we do, and we uphold their legacy." - Mair

Name: Midnight Madness!
Rules Text:
Spend Order: Return target opposing unequipped non-Warlord character in a first rank to its owner's hand.
Spend Order: Target opponent discards a card.
Flavor Text: The night grows dangerous when the God's Eye is full.

Name: Misearean Scout
Rules Text:
Misearean Scout is the same alignment, faction(s), and class(es) as your Warlord(s).
Spend Order: Perform a +0 ranged strike.
Flavor Text: "I found something interesting over the next ridge, but it'll cost you..."

Name: Mistress Allandra
Rules Text:
Spend Order: Perform a +4 ranged strike.
Limited React: After Mistress Allandra performs a ranged strike that killed the target: Ready her.
Flavor Text: "Perhaps, another chance at immortality..."

Name: Mo'can
Rules Text:
Spend Order: Perform two +4 ranged strikes.
Limited React: After an opposing character moves without spending or stunning: Move forward one rank or perform a +7 ranged strike.
Flavor Text: "Show me the way Mo'can. These Deverenians have lived too long on nothrog land." - Vactus

Name: Muddflek
Rules Text: Order: Perform a +8 ranged strike. Kill Muddflek.
Flavor Text: "Now there's a creature with flair!" - Sklot the Cruel

Name: Myerdeth Mare
Rules Text:
Limited Order: Spend Myerdeth Mare: Perform a +3 melee strike that may only target lower level characters.
Order: Spend Myerdeth Mare: Move forward one rank.
Flavor Text: "Ride on the edge of nightmare, my phantoms, my knights!" - Lord Belasco

Name: Nature's Ally
Rules Text: Spend Order: Put an Animal token into play within one rank. If this character is a Druid, Survey.
Flavor Text: "Always follow the Water, Naulisa. Find your strength there, and you allies." - Anacaona

Name: Nehil
Rules Text:
+2 Skill
React: After this character spends to cast a level 1 or 2 spell, spend Nehil: Ready this character.
Flavor Text: "Fly free, my friend. But don't forget about me down here." - Wa'San

Name: Nightfire Manacles
Rules Text:
This character gains Encumbered.
React: After this character equips Nightfire Manacles, spend Manacles: Equip Manacles to target opposing character within two ranks ignoring level requirements.
Flavor Text: "What do you mean we just started? I feel like we've been walking for days!" - Parthus

Name: Nisha
Rules Text:
Before the game begins, choose a faction. Nisha is that faction.
After starting armies are revealed, choose up to two classes. Nisha permanently gains those classes.
Flavor Text: "Could be my friends and I could help you--what's in it for us?"

Name: Noble Sacrifice
Rules Text: Spend React: After your character is targeted by a strike or action, and if this character is in a first rank, kill this character: Cancel the strike or action.
Flavor Text: "NO!" Wa'San screamed as the young troll stepped in the way of the blast.

Name: Nog, Pog, and Snivels
Rules Text:
Enter React: Perform a melee strike.
Death React: Perform a melee strike. Banish Nog, Pog, and Snivels.
Flavor Text: "The foodstores are completely destroyed, and you don't want to hear about the latrines." -Efrim

Name: Nothrog S'sike
Rules Text: React: After target opposing character moves to within one rank of this character, spend Nothrog S'sike: Perform a melee strike against the target.
Flavor Text: "Have the siege engines target their back ranks. Force them into our s'sikes." - Azh'kal

Name: Novice Pyro
Rules Text: Spend Order: Perform a +2 ranged strike.
Flavor Text: "Heh. Fire."

Name: Oracle of Kavara
Rules Text: Spend Order: Discard a card: Survey. Draw a card.
Flavor Text: "Be warned - if you ask the question, you'll have to learn the answer."

Name: Out of Options
Rules Text:
Your deck may include any number of cards named Out of Options
Order: This character gains your choice of +2 ATK or AC this turn.
Flavor Text: Desperate times make for strange decisions

Name: Overburdened Nag
Rules Text: Order: Spend Overburdened Nag: Move forward one rank.
Flavor Text: Neus' Order of the Harvest breeds horses for all occasions.

Name: Pack Tactics
Rules Text: Spend Order: Your two target characters attack (spending as normal).
Flavor Text: "Bears are solitary and hostile, eagles proud and aloof. Put your faith in wolves." - Annetta

Name: Percy Dorn
Rules Text: Spend Order: Perform a +0 ranged strike.
Flavor Text: Even in the depths of the wilds, the Heresy Hunters have eyes.

Name: Pin Down
Rules Text:
Order: Perform a +0 ranged strike. If the strike hits, the target may not move this turn unless falling forward.
Spend React: After target opposing character moves without spending: Spend the target.
Flavor Text: "Hold them there while we chase down the others."

Name: Pious Rebuke
Rules Text: Spend React: Before target opposing character performs a melee strike: The target must succeed with a will save (DC 10 + this character's skill) or the strike is canceled and the target performs a melee strike against a character in their army.
Flavor Text: "ENOUGH!" The Hunters' daggers shattered in their hands as Hellene's voice echoed with thunder.

Name: Polymorph
Rules Text: Order: Target your character: This turn, the target's base stats become level 2, +3/+3 ATK, 13 AC, +3 skill, and 2 HP, and they gain the Monster trait.
Flavor Text: "Life calls to life, as long as you're willing to pay the price." - Callow Rowan

Name: Pounce
Rules Text:
Order: Move forward one rank.
Spend React: After target character performs a melee strike that missed: Inflict a wound on the target.
Flavor Text: "What right do they have to know who killed them?" - Alrayn

Name: Premonition Pendant
Rules Text: Order: Spend Premonition Pendant: Survey.
Flavor Text: "Commander! Nothrog ambushers up ahead. We're in for a miserable afternoon." - Jorra the Morose

Name: Press the Attack
Rules Text: Spend Order: Target any number of your fighters: Each target moves forward one rank. Each target that moved may perform a +3 melee strike.
Flavor Text: The best way to avoid death is often to make peace with it.

Name: Prime Positioning
Rules Text:
Roll Order:
1-9: Move forward one rank.
10-19: This character gains +5 ATK this turn. Move forward one rank.
20: This character gains +5 ATK this turn. Move forward one rank. Perform a +15 melee strike.
Flavor Text: "Sloppy footwork will be your death, squire!" - Efrim

Name: Punitive Strike
Rules Text:
React: Before this character makes a melee strike roll: The strike gains +3 ATK.
Order: Perform a melee strike that may only target a stunned character.
Flavor Text: "The strong take what they will, and the weak suffer what they must." - Lord Belasco

Name: Quartermaster Dirge
Rules Text: Death React: Target Dwarven Forges character gains +1 level for equipping items this turn and another target character suffers -1 level for equipping items this turn.
Flavor Text: Seekers and Watchers alike must remember our sacrifices, and honor our dead.

Name: Quazlan Rivet
Rules Text: While Encumbered, Quazlan Rivet gains +5 ATK and an additional melee strike (base +0) while attacking.
Flavor Text: "What a strange way to cast a ssspell!" - Z'adok

Name: Quick Dodge
Rules Text: React: After this character is targeted with a strike: This character gains +5 AC for the strike.
Flavor Text: "Whew, almost had me there!" - Tresven

Name: Quick Shielding
Rules Text: React: After target character within two ranks is targeted with a strike: The target gains a bonus to AC equal to this character's level this turn.
Flavor Text: "No mortal can overcome of the power of Neus." - Adathan

Name: Quick Strength
Rules Text: React: Before target character within two ranks makes a melee strike roll: The target gains a bonus to ATK equal to this character's level this turn.
Flavor Text: "Try that again, beloved." - Shyessa

Name: Quicksilver Gargoyle
Rules Text: Limited React: Before Quicksilver Gargoyle suffers wounds: Ready it. This action may be performed while stunned.
Flavor Text: "Beautiful to look at, but try not to inhale." - Memoriam

Name: Ra'gar Root-Strength
Rules Text: Ra'Gar Root-Strength and your adjacent characters inflict an additional wound with melee strikes targeting Encumbered characters.
Flavor Text: There is no being powerful enought to rival nature. True strength comes from the world alone.

Name: Ramesh, Elder Sage
Rules Text:
After starting armies are revealed, choose a class. Ramesh, Elder Sage permanently gains that class.
Limited Order: Your other target Mercenary Guilds character gains +2 ATK and AC this turn.
Flavor Text: Fight for your family, fight for your future, fight for your life--all I ask is that you fight!

Name: Rapid Dash
Rules Text:
Roll Order:
1-9: Journey.
10-19: Journey. Perform an Order.
20: Move to the first rank of any formation. Gain Stealth +10 this turn.
Flavor Text: Joleg ran fastest with a fire lit under his ass.

Name: Recruiter of Misear
Rules Text: Spend React: After an opposing character enters play: Put a character into play. If you control a Mercenary Guilds Warlord, you may reduce the character's entering rank by one.
Flavor Text: "You there! Ever dream of a life of heroism?"

Name: Resurrection
Rules Text: Spend Order: Discard a card, target an equal or lower level character in your discard pile: Put the target into your hand.
Flavor Text: "Reach down the web, haul up the memories of the past. Unleash them on the present." - Shyessa

Name: Retreat from the Roil
Rules Text: Spend Order: Target each character in a rank within two ranks: Each target must succeed with a reflex save (DC 15) or move backward one rank.
Flavor Text: "Stay back! For your own good. I only wish to talk." - Shastra

Name: Revenger
Rules Text:
This character gains Dual Wield.
This character inflicts an additional wound with melee strikes while they have two or more Weapons equipped.
Flavor Text: "That's to kill you! And that's to make sure you stay dead!" - Rone

Name: Revitalizing Roots
Rules Text: Spend Order: Target up to three characters: Heal each target.
Flavor Text: "You aren't alone, young one. You never are." - Ra'Gar Root-Strength

Name: Riding Horse
Rules Text: Order: Spend Riding Horse: Move forward one rank.
Flavor Text: "We need three horses. Now. Whatever you have." - Mair

Name: Ritual Dagger
Rules Text: This character gains +2 ATK for each wounded character in play.
Flavor Text: The god of trickery acknowledges certain back-alley knifings as sacred acts.

Name: Rockarm
Rules Text: React: Before this character performs a melee strike, spend Rockarm: The strike inflicts an additional wound.
Flavor Text: It's not a greeting you want to receive.

Name: Rone of the Deepbrook
Rules Text: Your characters gain "Enter React: Perform a +1 ranged strike."
Flavor Text: "We shall live forever, in the breeze of a gentle day."

Name: Rrok
Rules Text:
Wounds inflicted by Rrok's melee strikes may not be reduced.
Limited Order: Move forward one rank.
Flavor Text: "It's been too long. The Legions must have a real war."

Name: Sacrifice
Rules Text: React: Before your target character suffers wounds, this character suffers a wound: Reduce the wounds the target suffers by one.
Flavor Text: "While one dwarf lives, the dwarves can never be defeated." - Memoriam

Name: Salvage
Rules Text: Limited React: Before target Dwarven Forges character is killed: Return an Armor, Shield, or Weapon equipped to the target to its owner's hand.
Flavor Text: "I can make this work!"

Name: Sand Fiend
Flavor Text: The Narawat Pantheon has grown resentful since the rise of Neus.

Name: Sanguicorn
Rules Text:
Sanguicorn's melee strikes inflict an additional wound if the roll is odd.
Limiter Order: Move Forward one rank.
Flavor Text: "They're not unicorns, that's for sure. But they're what we have left." - Annetta

Name: Sarakian SellSword
Rules Text: Sarakian Sellsword is the same alignment, factions, and classes as your Warlords.
Flavor Text: "Gold buys my service, but not my respect."

Name: Scale Mail
Rules Text: This character gains +2 AC while targeted with a ranged strike.
Flavor Text: "You won't pierce my armor from back there," Kurak roared. "Step closer and see if you have what it takes to bring me down."

Name: Scepter of Djarat
Rules Text: Order: Spend Scepter of Djarat: Target character within two ranks must succeed with a reflex save (DC 15) or spend and suffer a wound. Characters that were adjacent to the target must succeed with a reflex save (DC 10) or spend.
Flavor Text: "Djarat has once again begun to involve himself in the mortal world. War must be at hand." - Adathan

Name: Scout Pony
Rules Text: Order: Spend Scout Pony: Journey.
Flavor Text: "Speed isn't crucial--we won't be on a race track. It needs to sure-footed and able to turn on a dime." - Rone

Name: Seeker
Rules Text:
After starting armies are revealed, chose a class. Seeker permanently gains that class.
Limited Order: Your other target Dwarven Forges character gains +1 HP this turn.
Flavor Text: "Hold firm, comrades. We'll find a solution."

Name: Shadow Bolts
Rules Text: Spend Order: Perform a +4 ranged strike. If this character is a rogue, this strike inflicts an additional wound against spent characters. If this character is a wizard, perform another +4 ranged strike.
Flavor Text: "The firssst to kill the target, the sssecond to kill the witnessesss." - Z'adok

Name: Shadow Clan Slayer
Flavor Text: "We must make contact with the Shadow Castes!" - Gorthos

Name: Shadow Tunic
Flavor Text: "Darkness protects us, darkness gives us strength." -Shadow Clan saying

Name: Shambling Horror
Rules Text: Characters killed by Shambling Horror are banished instead.
Flavor Text: "No, no, that's not one of mine..." - Tazian

Name: Shannon the Daring
Rules Text:
Adjacent level 1 and 2 characters gain +2 ATK.
Limited React: After Shannon enters play or performs a melee strike: Level 1 and 2 Free Kingdoms characters in your first rank gain +2 ATK and AC this turn.
Flavor Text: "These fisherfolk have had to turn to pirates for protection! Let us show them that Free Kingdoms serve all of humanity."

Name: Shatter
Rules Text: Order: If this character is in a first rank, destroy target item in a first rank.
Flavor Text: "Well, this one is no good! Let's try again." - Otto

Name: Shield of Spurning
Rules Text: React: After target character performs a melee strike targeting this character, spend Shield of Spurning: Move the target backward one rank.
Flavor Text: The sigils bring a power all of their own, though well-made steel certainly doesn't hurt.

Name: Shield Rune
Rules Text:
Order: Equip a Simple Shield token to your target character.
Spend React: After a character is targeted by a ranged strike: Cancel the strike.
Flavor Text: "What the Seekers have yet to understand is that true creation is an act of faith." - Memoriam

Name: Shillelagh
Rules Text: This character gains a bonus to ATK equal to half their skill, rounded up.
Flavor Text: "When I have need of a weapon, the world provides." - Ra'Gar

Name: ShockSaber
Rules Text:
This character gains advantage on melee strikes targeting Planar characters.
React: After this character is targeted with a ranged strike, spend Shocksaber: Gain +10 AC for the duration of the strike.
Flavor Text: "'Tis a woundrous thing to stab a ghost. They never see it coming." - Tancred

Name: Shrapnelball
Rules Text: Destroy Order: Target up to three characters within two ranks: Perform a +0 ranged strike against each target.
Flavor Text: "Yep, that'd do it." - Graham Heyward

Name: Shyessa the Weaver
Rules Text: Your characters have "Death React: Survey." Limited Order: Discard up to two cards: Draw a card for each card discarded.
Flavor Text: "They are my pets, stuck in my web, I shall play with them how I wish."

Name: Silversteel Gauntlets
Rules Text: React: Before this character targets a strike, spend Silversteel Gauntlets: This character gains True Strike for the strike.
Flavor Text: "Focus and discipline. Whether or not you connect with any given strike is always up to you." - Retsov

Name: Simple Shield
Rules Text: Destroy React: Before this character suffers wounds: Reduce the wounds by one.

Name: Sister Amanda
Rules Text:
Sister Amanda enters play as level 5.
Limited Spend React: After target Free Kingdoms character performs a Spend Order: Ready the target.
Flavor Text: "Every day I praise Neus that Amanda found her way to us. Never has an adult recruit shown such promise." - Efrim

Name: Sister Kiren
Rules Text: Limited Order: Your target higher level Deverenian Empire character Journeys.
Flavor Text: "Breathe in--feel the charge in the air. The Storm shall come anon..."

Name: Skitterleap
Rules Text:
Skitterleap's spells inflict an additional wound against spent characters.
React: After your character dies: Spend target lower level character within two ranks.
Flavor Text: None are safe while Skitterleap draws breath.

Name: Sklot the Cruel
Rules Text: Order: Twice per turn, destroy an equipped item: Perform a +6 ranged strike. After the strike, each character that was adjacent to the target must succeed with a reflex save (DC 12) or suffer a wound and spend.
Flavor Text: It's not about where you stick 'em, it's about watching their face as they realize it's over.

Name: Skulk in the shallows
Rules Text:
Roll Spend Order:
1-9: Your target equal or lower level character Journeys.
10-19: Up to two of your target equal or lower characters Journey.
20: Any number of your target equal or lower level characters Journey.
Flavor Text: For a century the Cult of Bascaron has grown in the shadows--now its horrors spill out into the light of day.

Name: Skyborne Initiate
Flavor Text: "There's been an ooze sighted in the third basement, send some of the initiates." - Augustin

Name: Sleep
Rules Text: Spend Order: Target two level 1 characters or one level 2 character. Each target must succeed with a magic save (DC 13) or stun.
Flavor Text: "See that they do not wake." - Lord Belasco

Name: Sneak
Rules Text: React: After this character is targeted with a non-attack action: Succeed with a perception check (DC 18) to cancel the action.
Flavor Text: Old wives' tales claim that thinking of the Gaunt will draw their attention. This makes it easy for Alrayn to pass unnoticed.

Name: Sneak Attack
Rules Text: Order: Perform a +4 melee strike that may only target a spent character.
Flavor Text: Even as he drew his sword, the elf's bone blades were tearing into his flesh.

Name: Solar Ray
Rules Text: Order: Target character within two ranks must succeed with a will save (DC = 5 + this character's skill) or suffer a wound. Undead characters suffer two wounds instead.
Flavor Text: "None can stand against the power of the heavens." - Adathan

Name: Spellblocker
Flavor Text: Belasco laughed as the spell fizzled against his shield. "Time to see thy swordplay, mage."

Name: Spiked Pit Trap
Rules Text: Spend Order: Target a rank: Whenever a character moves into that rank this turn, they must succeed with a reflex save (DC 12) or suffer a wound.
Flavor Text: For a few seconds, the sutek thought they'd found a way into the camp undetected.

Name: Spiritual Weapon
Rules Text: Order: Perform a melee strike with a bonus equal to this character's level. This character gains Reach for the strike.
Flavor Text: "Don't think, let Kor guide your hand." -Kurak

Name: Spit Fire
Rules Text: Spend Order: Target character within two ranks must succeed with a reflex save (DC 13) or suffer a wound. If this character is a Dragon, target up to two characters instead.
Flavor Text: The Bear Legion's pyromancers watched in awe as Hagunk completed the demonstration.

Name: Squire Argos
Rules Text: Other equal or lower level Free Kingdoms characters in this rank gain +2 ATK and +1 AC.
Flavor Text: "Sutek in Merrick, nothrog in Misear, and now Deverenian zealots in Llyr? This must be answered!"

Name: Squire Fendric
Rules Text: Limited Order: Spend a character in this rank: Move forward one rank. If Squire Fendric moves, he may perform a melee strike.
Flavor Text: "My blade shall take thy breath."

Name: Squire Parthus
Rules Text: Spend Order: Perform a number of melee strikes equal to Squire Parthus' level.
Flavor Text: "He stumbled upon our camp in the night, hungry and searching for purpose." - Jerrin Foluke

Name: Sta'ash
Rules Text: React: Before target character is killed by Sta'ash: If the target is higher level, heal (remove a wound from) Sta'ash. If the target is lower level, banish it after it dies.
Flavor Text: "Ah, brother, covered in blood, once again." - Z'adok

Name: Starbinder
Rules Text: Limited React: After your target character moves: The target gains your choice of +3 ATK or AC this turn.
Flavor Text: The last time the nothrog crossed the Wenizi in strength, they met a company of Silversteel Starbinders. They crossed back without ever realizing it.

Name: Steady Grip
Rules Text: Order: This character gains +2 ATK and True Strike this turn.
Flavor Text: "No use having a sword if you're going to drop it." - Azh'kal

Name: Steel Darts
Rules Text: Order: Spend Steel Darts: Perform a +0 ranged strike.
Flavor Text: "They'll give a good clean puncture, which is why I usually carve mine up a bit, make them harder getting out." - Sklot the Cruel

Name: Steelforge Regalia
Rules Text: Kill React: Twice per turn: Perform a melee strike.
Flavor Text: "The pride of Steelforge's smiths. And that's saying something." - Anvil

Name: Stirges
Rules Text: Limited React: After Stirges perform a melee strike that hit: Perform a melee strike.
Flavor Text: "A swarm will skin a man faster than one would ever guess"

Name: Storm Shard
Rules Text: Order: Ready each of your Warlords. Draw a card for each Warlord readied this way. Banish Storm Shard. Characters may not react to or during this action.
Flavor Text: "Convene the Council. It has begun." -Shastra

Name: Storm's Attendant
Rules Text: Limited Order: If Storm's Attendant is adjacent to a higher level character: Survey (Look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put any number of them on top or bottom in any order.)
Flavor Text: Limited Order: If Storm's Attendant is adjacent to a higher level character: Survey (Look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put any number of them on top or bottom in any order.)

Name: Stormlord
Rules Text: At end of turn kill your Dev character or kill this character.

Name: Strongarm Stout
Rules Text: Destroy Order: Each player draws a card. This turn, this character gains +2 ATK and +1 HP for each card drawn this way.
Flavor Text: It takes both a strong arm and a strong stomach to down a pint of Rockhome brew.

Name: Summon Avalanche
Rules Text: Spend Order: Target each character in a rank within two ranks: Each target must succeed with a reflex save (DC 14) or spend. Spent characters stun instead. Stunned characters suffer a wound instead.
Flavor Text: "Misear may soon learn that Nature defends itself." - Wa'San Wolf-Spirit

Name: Sunfire Aegis
Rules Text: React: After target adjacent character is targeted with a strike, spend Sunforge Aspis: The target gains +2 AC for the strike.
Flavor Text: "Every temple of Kor abuts a smithy, and no forge is complete without a shrine." - Kurak

Name: Sunforge Smith
Rules Text: Spend Order: Target your wounded Dwarven Forges character: Unstun the target, or the target performs a +2 melee strike.
Flavor Text: "I haven't sold an axe in months. Above ground all they want are swords; the shinier the better."

Name: Sunseeker's Goggles
Rules Text: +2 skill
Flavor Text: Many early Seekers went blind before the artificers arrived at a solution.

Name: Sutek Razorclaw
Rules Text: Sutek Razorclaw's melee strikes may target spent characters an additional rank away.
Flavor Text: "There are so many..." - Huggins

Name: Sutek Shank
Rules Text:
This character's melee strikes inflict an additional wound against stunned characters.
Death React: Equip this item to an adjacent Sutek ignoring level requirements.
Flavor Text: A crude weapon for a cruel task.

Name: Sutek Slimefang
Rules Text: Death React: Spend target opposing character within one rank.
Flavor Text: "Itz eazy, poison onz the blade, poison inz the enemy!"

Name: Swampbook
Rules Text:
+1 Skill
React: After another character within one rank is targeted by a strike, spend Swampbook: Redirect the strike to a character adjacent to the strike's original target.
Flavor Text: "Written in the blood of our enemiesss." - Z'adok

Name: Swift
Rules Text: Order: Journey.
Flavor Text: "We'll drive the brutes into the canyon. Graham, rush ahead and cut them off." - Mair

Name: Switftcloud
Rules Text:
Limited Order: Journey.
Limited Order: Put a character into play from your hand ignoring loyalty penalty. If it is a Mercenary Guilds character, you may reduce it's entering rank by one.
Flavor Text: "At long last." - Retsov

Name: Swivel
Rules Text: React: Before this character targets a ranged strike: Gain Marksmanship +5 for the strike. Journey.
Flavor Text: Gurth'ak stopped short; the fleeing elf had spun around, bow in hand. A blackoak arrow sprouted from Gurth'ak's chest.

Name: Tazian Dythanus
Rules Text: Limited Order: Target up to two characters in any discard piles: Banish the targets. Perform a +3 ranged strike for each character banished this way.
Flavor Text: Life is all around us, waiting to be remade.

Name: Talisman of Faith
Rules Text: Your clerics in this rank gain +1 AC.
Flavor Text: The symbol of Athanaes, respected throughout the Accordlands.

Name: Talisman of Might
Rules Text: Your fighters in this rank gain +1 ATK.
Flavor Text: A mark of respect, given to a warrior by a defeated Havat-lahn.

Name: Tattered Armaments
Rules Text: Your deck may include any number of cards named Tattered Armaments.
Flavor Text: "I'm not going to the tavern with you if you're wearing that!"

Name: Taumar the Protector
Rules Text: Each Deverenian Empire fighter in the rank in front of Taumar the Protector gains +2 AC and skill.
Flavor Text: He flies through the mountain passes, searching for intruders.

Name: Terrorize
Rules Text:
Roll Order: Target a character within two ranks,
1-9: The target suffers -2 AC and skill this turn.
10-19: The target suffers -4 AC and skill this turn.
20: The target suffers -4 AC and skill this turn. Its controller banishes a card from their hand.
Flavor Text: "Flesh, Blood, Spirit. A mind can be twisted the same as a body." - Tazian

Name: Teufeltiger's Shroud
Rules Text: Limited React: After this character is targeted by a strike: Redirect the strike to an adjacent character.
Flavor Text: Teufeltiger crept into the Dragon's lair and stole its eggs, saving the world and damning it.

Name: TFK Brigand
Rules Text:
Strikes targeting TFK Brigand inflict an additional wound.
Spend Order: Stun TFK Brigand: Perform a +0 ranged strike.
Flavor Text: Robert Midgley, 2023 Gen Con Champion

Name: The Mighty Mugg
Rules Text: Limited Order: Target your adjacent equal or lower level character: Move the target forward up to two ranks. The target suffers a wound, then may perform a melee strike.
Flavor Text: "Mugg make anything fly!"

Name: The Quick and The Dead
Rules Text: Spend Order: Each Warlord makes an initiative roll with a bonus equal to their ATK. If your Warlord wins the roll, your target character performs two melee strikes.
Flavor Text: By the end of the battle, you know which you are.

Name: Thicket
Rules Text: Enter React: Characters in your first rank gain +3 AC while targeted with ranged strikes this turn.
Flavor Text: "I thought I knew what freedom was!"

Name: Throwing Shield
Rules Text: Destroy Order: Perform a +0 ranged strike.
Flavor Text: You know what they say about the best defense.

Name: Thunic Yeti
Rules Text: Kill React: Characters that were adjacent to the killed character must succeed with a fortitude save (DC 18) or spend.
Flavor Text: "I'd rather freeze to death than see the Yeti's tracks. Keep moving!"

Name: Tide Turner
Rules Text: Order: You may spend this character: Perform a +3 melee strike. If the strike hits, move the target backward one rank, or two ranks if you spent this character.
Flavor Text: "Any modern artificer working on a mechanical arm thinks about that punch." -Otto

Name: Tinker
Rules Text: Tinker may equip items regardless of class restrictions and gains +1 level for equipping them.
Flavor Text: "The Everseek Arsenal is a wonder of the world. Rockhome needs these weapons!"

Name: Trap
Rules Text: Destroy React: After target character targets this character with a strike: The target must succeed with a reflex save (DC 10) or suffer a wound.

Name: Tresven
Rules Text:
Enter React: Perform a +4 ranged strike that may only target a spent character.
Spend Order: Perform a +1 ranged strike.
Flavor Text: "I remember naught but my target."

Name: Treyik
Rules Text:
After Treyik is discarded from your hand, you may put him into play.
Order: Kill one of your Undead: Target Elven Branches character gains +3 ATK and AC this turn.
Flavor Text: "Each one a part of me." - Treyik Netheryn

Name: Treyik Netheryn
Rules Text:
React: After you discard a card from your hand: Banish it.
Spend Order: Banish Treyik Netheryn: Put up to 3 cards banished using his other printed ability into your hand.
Flavor Text: "Their mind fractured, their power multipled."

Name: Trinket of Malice
Rules Text: When Trinket of Malice enters your discard pile, choose a character in an opposing first rank who suffers -2 AC and skill this turn, then banish Trinket of Malice.
Flavor Text: Rone stared off into the distance, then drew his bow. "They aren't expecting us."

Name: Trogid
Rules Text: Death React: Your target Monster Journeys (moves forward or backward one rank).
Flavor Text: "Oh gods, the walls are moving! Run!!!!!!"

Name: Tunnel Vanguard
Rules Text: Adjacent Dwarven Forges characters gain +1 HP.
Flavor Text: "For a thousand years, the Blackstone Raiders fought tooth and claw against the creatures of the Abyss. They defeated a god. You think a century of peace has made us soft? Try us, beast-a dwarf never forgets!" - Kurak

Name: Tunnel Worm
Rules Text: Kill React: Move your target character in this rank to a different position in this rank.
Flavor Text: "Don't go down that one, manling. That's not one of ours." - Memoriam

Name: Tyren Ruskin
Rules Text: Spend React: Before target character in this rank suffers wounds, wound Tyren: Reduce the wounds the target would suffer by one.
Flavor Text: A society of equals, each one willing to shed blood for the safety of any of the others.

Name: Unicorn of Thun
Rules Text:
+2 Skill
Order: Spend Unicorn of Thun: Journey.
Order: Spend Unicorn of Thun and banish two action cards from your discard pile: Heal this character.
Flavor Text: "They are here to be found by the worthy." - Wa'San

Name: Unsummon
Rules Text: Spend Order: Return target unequipped character in a first rank to its owner's hand. If this character is a Warlock, Survey.

Name: Vactus Spirit's Champion
Rules Text: Limited Order: Move forward one rank.
Flavor Text: "My Champion, my River of Blood." - Wyvern

Name: Valdimar
Rules Text: Limited React: After an adjacent Dwarven Forges character equips an item: Ready Valdimar.
Flavor Text: "For ten years I fought with him as Faithful. He has more than earned his True Name." - Kurak

Name: Vanguard's Presence
Rules Text: Spend Order: Spend Vanguard's Presence: Ready target lower level non-stunned character.
Flavor Text: Try as they might, the nothrog could not reach the Denskan banner behind its iron-willed defenders.

Name: Veera and Bones
Rules Text:
Enter React: Each opponent discards a card.
Death React: Each opponent discards a card. Banish Veera and Bones.
Flavor Text: "A foul creation," spat Barrow. "Don't bring it near the library!"

Name: Venomtipped Arrows
Rules Text: React: After this character hits target character with a ranged strike: The target must succeed with a fortitude save (DC 13) or spend.
Flavor Text: "Listen you wretched creature--when I say arrows, I always means venomtipped arrows." - Sklot

Name: Veteren Bowman
Rules Text: Spend Order: Perform a +3 ranged strike.
Flavor Text: The demand for bowmen has risen across the Accordlands

Name: Viscous Goo
Rules Text:
Sutek may perform this action without spending.
Spend Order: Perform a +5 ranged strike that stuns instead of wounds.
Flavor Text: One touch and you'll never see again.

Name: Walk on Wind
Rules Text: Order: Move another target character in this rank forward or backward one rank. If this character is a Shaman, this character may Journey.
Flavor Text: "This is the path less traveled." -Wa'San

Name: War Horse
Rules Text:
Order: Spend War Horse: Move forward one rank.
Order: Spend War Horse: Gain +2 ATK this turn.
Flavor Text: "With well-trained creatures like these, you could lead a squadron against an army." -Retsov

Name: Warboss Azh'kal
Rules Text:
Your fighters who have moved this turn gain Powerattack +5.
Limited Order: Target your fighter and choose two: The target moves forward one rank; gains +5 ATK this turn; gains advantage on their next melee strike this turn; or performs a melee strike.
Flavor Text: Kill or be killed. Only a fool leaves weapons on the table.

Name: Wa'San Wolf-Spirit
Rules Text:
Limited Order: Perform a +4 ranged strike.
Limited Order: Put an Animal token into play adjacent to Wa'San Wolf-Spirit.
Flavor Text: "This land is not the domain of your god, nor any other. If you would harm its creatures, you must answer to us."

Name: Well of Screams
Rules Text: Spend Order: Reveal the top 10 cards of your deck. Each of your characters may equip one revealed item that they may legally equip. Then shuffle.
Flavor Text: "Nothing gets the assistants more excited than the arrival of new materials." - Master Otto

Name: Well Supplied
Rules Text: Spend Order: Reveal the top 10 cards of your deck. Each of your characters may equip one revealed item that they may legally equip. Then shuffle.
Flavor Text: "Nothing gets the assistants more excited than the arrival of new materials." - Master Otto

Name: Wither
Rules Text: Order: Perform a melee strike that does not inflict wounds. If the strike hits, the target suffers -3 levels this turn.
Flavor Text: "We have been here from the beginning, and will be here after the end." - That Which Speaks

Name: Woestone
Rules Text: This character suffers disadvantage on strike rolls.
Flavor Text: "The future of the Elves has been with the Undying since the first Dythanus made himself into a lich. Everything else has been a distraction." Boloph Ka 2:14

Name: Wraithstalker
Rules Text: Order: Spend Wraithstalker and discard the top two cards of your deck: Perform a melee strike targeting a character in the last rank of an opposing formation that inflicts an additional wound.
Flavor Text: "I see you...." Alrayn

Name: Xcalam Coatl
Rules Text:
+3 skill
Order: Spend Xcalam Coatl: You and target opponent both reveal the top card of your decks. If your card is higher level, your next die roll this turn gains advantage.
Flavor Text: Revered by sutek, despised by griffons.

Name: Yanthorine
Rules Text: Yanthorine gains +1 level for casting spells.

Name: Yscarite Berserker
Flavor Text: The innocent need true champions."

Name: Z'adok, Prey Herder
Rules Text:
Your Sutek gain +2 to strike rolls while targeting spent characters.
Limited Order: Perform a melee strike. Z'adok, Prey Herder gains Reach for the strike. If the strike hits, spend the target.
Flavor Text: "We shall drown the world in the crimson light of Bascaron!"

Name: Zaina
Rules Text: React: After an opposing character targets Zaina with a non-melee strike action: Perform a melee strike.
Flavor Text: "When the Storm demands silence, the Church sends Zaina." - High Acolyte Hellene
